Population increased in Kingston upon Thames

The estimated population of Kingston upon Thames in 2024 was 172,692 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Kingston upon Thames' rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Kingston upon Thames increased by 2.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Kingston upon Thames was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Kingston upon Thames

The average (median) age fell to 38.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Kingston upon Thames has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Kingston upon Thames is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Kingston upon Thames' population of 172,692 usual residents was made up of:

  • 32,844 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19%)
  • 113,922 people aged 16 to 64 years, (66%)
  • 25,926 people aged 65 years and over, (15%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Kingston upon Thames has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (15% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Kingston upon Thames, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Kingston upon Thames
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Kingston upon Thames, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 559 people (0.3%). In total, there were 1,660 births and 1,101 deaths in Kingston upon Thames.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 1,496 (-0.9%). There were 14,732 people entering the area and 16,228 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Kingston upon Thames' population of 2,853 (1.7%) as a result of 5,038 people entering the area and 2,185 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Kingston upon Thames was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Kingston upon Thames in mid-2023 is 170,780.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 532 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 206 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 326 people.
